question: As announced by Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) in February 2025, what is the weight of the world's largest vertical propellant mixer for solid rocket motors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 tonnes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** announced in **February 2025** the successful development of the **world's largest vertical propellant mixer** for solid rocket motors.
 
• The vertical propellant mixer has a weight of **10 tonnes**, making it the **heaviest and largest** of its kind globally.
 
• This mixer is a crucial component for producing **solid propellant rocket motors**, widely used in space missions for their reliability and efficiency.
 
• The mixer was designed and built with cutting-edge technology to handle the precise mixing requirements of **solid propellant ingredients** critical for rocket propulsion.
 
• This achievement highlights India's growing capability in developing **advanced space technologies** to support its ambitious space exploration programs.
